name: Pochi
source:
Likes: Hanging out in front of the dormitory, eating good food.

A demonic dog of the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cerberus]Cerberus[/url] breed, but for unknown reasons she was not born with three heads but only one so [url=/c38915]Aifa[/url] considers her a big failure. Pochi's role is simple, she must keep the dormitory as if it were the gates of Hell and be merciless towards anyone thinking of entering it without having made any offerings to Aifa, the dormitory manager.

Despite her great responsibilities and her great diabolical mission, Pochi spends her life hanging out and defending her bowl from the unbearable [url=/c43667]Gome[/url].

"Wunwun!"
